title: Pay and expenses on the road
summary: With $24 a night, work only a few nights a week and two sets of expenses, musicians like him and Harry Edison could barely save.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yes, it is. That goes along with the business. It shouldn't. You don't save much money. You've got to pay two expenses. You've got to pay at home, you've got to keep that going and you've got to pay your hotel and your expenses on the road which can be kind of high. So you can't hardly save very much. At least we couldn't. Not in those days. You might

can save a little more now because you get paid more. But we, when Basie, when we were making thirty-three dollars a week in the Savoy, when we weren't on a steady job, our salary was twenty-four dollars a night. But we never worked over three or four nights a week. We laid off, so if we worked four nights we got ninety-six dollars.
But we, sometimes we worked two nights or three nights because we weren't known then.
This was when you were playing one nighters?

Yes. We weren't known enough to work as much as Basie works now. So we'd work two nights a week and make forty-eight dollars or three nights a week make another twenty-four. We never made seven times twenty-four, never.
But you were away from home so that you would have seven hotels?

Yes, but we had that and I was still trying to send money home. But as I said, my wife was always dancing and she was making money which made it a little easier. But the guys that had wives like Ed Lewis, and kids, their wives had to stay home with the kids and see that

they got to school. So they couldn't afford too much money. People like me and Harry Edison we would make it and spend it. Because we would try to keep the home going but other than that we was always, when you get through work you are going to go out and see what's all over the town in bars and places. That's the typical life. It was, I don't know if it is now.
